newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bond yields close lower on brisk buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bond yields close lower on brisk buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds and three-month CDs closed lower on Monday on brisk buying boosted by the Bank of Korea's supply of 1.26 trillion won to the banking system, dealers said.
The market reopened after being closed on Friday and Saturday for Lunar New Year holidays.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.93 pct vs Thursday's 12.00 pct
* 3-mth CDs end at 12.20 pct vs 12.25 pct
* Average overnight call rate flat at 11.5 pct
